note: THE CONTROL THAT SAYS BOUND IS NOT A SHORTER SUBJECT.  Emacs answers (nil nil 6 nil): `\\'' and `$' keep asking about the real end of the buffer, never about BOUND, so an anchored pattern does not become matchable by bounding the search -- while element three shows the same pattern matching with no bound at all.  Implementing BOUND by handing the matcher a truncated copy of the row would answer (5 5 6 5) and is the reason the engine takes a limit PARAMETER instead.
